subject: Request: NimbleMed conditional credit & packaging exception — VP/CFO sign-off
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Bcc: 
Date: 2027-05-19T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: NimbleMed conditional credit & packaging exception — VP/CFO sign-off

Team,

NimbleMed (clinical imaging SaaS) is asking for an exception to our standard starter-credit and tiering rules. They’ve verbally committed to a 3-year engagement (annual minimums ramping 40%/60%/100%) and want a one-time conditional credit tied to first-year committed usage to offset their integration and validation costs.

Why this matters:
- Strategic footprint: NimbleMed is a strong channel for us into mid-market radiology groups and they asked for Redwood to be the "default" inference provider in an upcoming integration marketplace listing (marketing + co-sell).
- Economics: They will commit to $1.2M ARR in year 3 (customer-provided forecast) with a modest pilot in year 1. If we approve the credit, we accelerate deployment and the marketplace placement, which we believe materially increases our win-rate in the vertical.

Request (what I need from finance/leadership):
- Approve a one-time conditional credit equal to 25% of year-1 committed usage (applied as usage credits over 12 months).
- Allow packaging exception: split billing model (Committed GPU pool + overage per-token consumption) instead of our standard single SKU for this customer.
- Signoff text for contract addendum (I attached a draft memo + updated SOW).

Risk mitigations included in the proposal:
- 12-month minimum payable for committed capacity even if usage falls short.
- Credit clawback if customer terminates before 12 months (pro-rata recoupment).
- Performance SLA at standard rates; fallback to smaller model variant if capacity spikes.

Attachments: nimblemed_proposal_v3.pdf, redwood_exception_memo_nw-1794.docx, deal_summary_nw-1794.xlsx

I've summarized the expected margin impact in the spreadsheet (tab: Finance-Impact). Net of credit and expected caching gains, we estimate ~30% gross margin in year 1 (rising to 55%+ by year 3).

Asking for an explicit VP/CFO sign-off so legal can finalize the contract addendum. Suggested approve-by: EOB Monday (5/24) to keep momentum for their internal board decision.

Thanks,

Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: NimbleMed conditional credit & packaging exception — VP/CFO sign-off

Avery — thanks for the clear memo and the financials. I agree this is a strategic opportunity and the marketplace placement is valuable.

Quick clarifications that would make this easier for Laura to greenlight:
- Confirm the legal-approved clawback language (I left a comment in the exception memo).
- Recommend we cap the total upfront credit at $150k (even if 25% of year-1 committed would be higher), to limit downside and keep bookkeeping simple.
- Require a committed start date within 60 days of contract signature or the credit drops to 50%.

If finance signs off on the cap and the clawback, I support the packaging exception. Can someone update the memo to include the $150k cap and the 60-day start clause?

-Markus

Markus Klein
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: NimbleMed conditional credit & packaging exception — VP/CFO sign-off

Team — I read the proposal and spreadsheet. A few finance/legal items I need answered before I can sign:

1) ARR recognition and timing: confirm how we will recognize revenue for the committed GPU pool vs. usage billing. If we accept a $150k credit, we need to ensure revenue recognition isn't accelerated in a way that creates a quarter-1 hole. Please confirm proposed revenue deferral approach.

2) Downside protection: I like the 12-month minimum and clawback. Add language that the credit is earned only if all milestones in the attached SOW are met (integration milestones + acceptance tests).

3) Margin sensitivity: The 30% year-1 margin is acceptable only if caching and batching assumptions hold. Please include an explicit conservative scenario (no caching) in the spreadsheet and show the worst-case margin.

4) Approval text: Draft the exact CFO approval line we can apply to the exception memo (one sentence). I will not sign until the cap ($150k) and milestone language are in the memo and the conservative sensitivity is attached.

Please update and re-send. If we can get a final version by EOD Friday (5/21), I will review and aim to sign Monday morning.

Laura Bennett
Chief Financial Officer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Susan Park <susan.park@nimblemed.com>, procurement@nimblemed.com
Date: 2027-05-21T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: NimbleMed conditional credit & packaging exception — VP/CFO sign-off

Laura/Markus/Marissa —

Thanks — updated materials attached. Summary of changes per Laura's ask:
- Exception memo updated: capped credit set to $150,000 and explicit clawback tied to milestone acceptance (see §3.2 of the memo).
- Revenue recognition note (tab: Finance-Impact): we will defer recognition of the credit over 12 months against committed capacity revenue; usage overage is recognized as billed. Conservative no-caching scenario added (tab: Sensitivity-NoCache) showing year-1 margin floor at ~18%.
- SOW: added three integration milestones (API onboarding, validation dataset pass, production smoke test) that trigger credit vesting.

I also drafted the CFO approval line you requested: "Approved by CFO for one-time conditional credit cap ($150,000) and packaging exception as documented in Redwood Internal Exception Memo NW-1794, contingent on milestone acceptance as defined in SOW.§3."

If that wording looks good I can route it for signature (I included a DocuSign link placeholder in related_links). Legal has OK'd the clawback language as inserted.

Next steps: Laura — if you can review the updated memo and approval line, I’ll route for your e-signature. Once signed I’ll finalize the addendum with NimbleMed (they’ve asked to align signatures this week).

Thanks,

Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com
